I was certain I'd found a diamond in the rough when I stumbled upon the Yongnuo YN433 II Camera. A Full 4K, Micro 4/3, USB-connected webcam for under $400 is an absurd deal, given the cheapest Sony still goes for $750, and Canon and Panasonic are locked at 1080P over USB on their $500 models. Could this be THE high quality webcam I've been waiting for? Or is this Android-powered smartphone reject with a 20MP Sony Sensor just eWaste that hasn't hit the recycler yet?
